environment.description: Legacy monolith deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e9b1d4e5f6) in us-east-1, running as a Docker container with host networking. Instance has IAM role 'legacy-app-role' with ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. IMDSv1 is enabled (HttpTokens: optional). Application is exposed via classic ELB on port 443 with no WAF. No network restrictions on outbound traffic from the container.
